title: Settings Checked IDs
prompt: A React settings checkbox group stores selected ids. Write a helper that adds the id when checked is true and removes it when checked is false, without duplicates.

explanation.beginner:
Example: settingsCheckedIds(["a"], "b", true) produces ["a","b"]. Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Compare “removes unchecked ids”: input [["a","b"],"a",false] produces ["b"]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Tempting mistake: A projection is different from filtering: returning a boolean from map gives booleans, while returning a value from filter only makes a keep decision.

The reference uses includes, filter. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “removes unchecked ids”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
